title: MPT1327: two control channels
description: Two sites' forward control channels on 165.2 MHz in turn (SYS 0x42E1 at 100 deg, SYS 0x42E7 at 345 deg): CCSC + Aloha codewords, BCH-checked. Expect site talkers 'SYS 42E1' and 'SYS 42E7' at those bearings.

title: MPT1327 trunking: a control channel and two calls on traffic channels
description: Site SYS 0x2C35 (made up), MPT 1343 Band III channel numbers (Channel plan option): control channel CH 100 on 202.4500 MHz (bearing 300 deg) with grants for group 042-0100 from 042-1234 on CH 60 (201.9500 MHz, 1.0 s, repeated at 3, 5, 7 s), an emergency unit-to-unit call 042-2001 -> 042-0555 on CH 132 (202.8500 MHz, 6.0 s, AHY + ACKE first) and a data call on CH 75 (10.5 s, not followed); announced control channel CH 110, an adjacent site, call maintenance parameters. The traffic channels' downlinks: CH 60 at 40 deg (042-1234, then 042-1300 talk; clear-down 6.2 s), CH 132 at 200 deg (042-2001, 042-0555, 042-2001 with disconnect; clear-down 12.3 s) - Pressel On / periodic / Pressel Off call maintenance repeated by the site, made-up speech-like FM audio between. Expect (system) / (grant) on VFO 0, a voice VFO per call, talkers 042-1234 and 042-1300 at 40 deg, 042-2001 and 042-0555 at 200 deg, the site SYS 2C35 at 300 deg.
